# Fig 2B
```{r, fig.height=4, fig.width=4}

# Cell density per mm^2 — per-ROI computation, patient-level statistics
#
# What this chunk does:
#   1. Computes cell DENSITY (cells per mm^2) per ROI per cell type.
#      Each ROI area in mm^2 = width_px * height_px * (PIXEL_UM / 1000)^2,
#      assuming the IMC acquisition uses `PIXEL_UM` micrometres per pixel
#      (Hyperion IMC is standardly 1 um/px — change below if yours differs).
#
#   2. Aggregates multiple ROIs from the same patient (median density across
#      ROIs) to give ONE value per patient per cell type. This avoids
#      pseudoreplication when ROIs from the same patient are not independent.
#
#   3. Runs Kruskal-Wallis (omnibus, HC vs EN vs EI) per cell type,
#      with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction across cell types.
#
#   4. Runs Dunn's post-hoc pairwise test (HC-EN, HC-EI, EN-EI) per cell type
#      with BH correction within each cell type.
#
#   5. Plots patient-level boxplots with individual patient dots and
#      pairwise significance brackets for significant comparisons only.

# ---- IMC pixel size (micrometres per pixel). Standard Hyperion = 1. ----
PIXEL_UM <- 1

# ---- helper: compute cell density (cells / mm^2) per ROI ----
get_density_per_roi <- function(spe, pixel_um = 1) {
  meta <- as.data.frame(colData(spe))

  # area per ROI in mm^2
  # 1 mm = 1000 um, so area_mm2 = (width_px * pixel_um / 1000) * (height_px * pixel_um / 1000)
  area_tbl <- meta %>%
    dplyr::distinct(sample_id, patient_id, indication, width_px, height_px) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(area_mm2 = (width_px * pixel_um / 1000) *
                              (height_px * pixel_um / 1000))

  # counts per (ROI, celltype)
  counts_tbl <- meta %>%
    dplyr::count(sample_id, patient_id, indication, celltype, name = "cell_count")

  # make sure every (ROI x celltype) combination exists (fill zeros)
  counts_tbl <- counts_tbl %>%
    tidyr::complete(
      tidyr::nesting(sample_id, patient_id, indication),
      celltype,
      fill = list(cell_count = 0)
    )

  counts_tbl %>%
    dplyr::left_join(area_tbl %>% dplyr::select(sample_id, area_mm2),
                     by = "sample_id") %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(area_mm2) & area_mm2 > 0) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(density_per_mm2 = cell_count / area_mm2)
}

# ROI-level density
roi_df <- get_density_per_roi(spe, pixel_um = PIXEL_UM)
roi_df$indication <- factor(roi_df$indication, levels = c("HC", "EN", "EI"))

# patient-level density: median across ROIs per patient
patient_df <- roi_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(patient_id, indication, celltype) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(density_per_mm2 = median(density_per_mm2, na.rm = TRUE),
                   .groups = "drop")

# ---- minimum observations per group required to run a test for a cell type ----
MIN_N_PER_GROUP <- 2

# helper: check if a cell type has enough observations across enough groups
has_enough_obs <- function(d, min_n = MIN_N_PER_GROUP, min_groups = 2) {
  n_per_group <- d %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(density_per_mm2)) %>%
    dplyr::count(indication) %>%
    dplyr::filter(n >= min_n)
  nrow(n_per_group) >= min_groups
}

# ---- Kruskal-Wallis per cell type (omnibus) + BH across cell types ----
kw_stats <- purrr::map_dfr(
  sort(unique(as.character(patient_df$celltype))),
  function(ct) {
    d <- patient_df %>% dplyr::filter(celltype == ct)
    if (!has_enough_obs(d)) return(NULL)
    out <- tryCatch(
      rstatix::kruskal_test(d, density_per_mm2 ~ indication),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(out)) return(NULL)
    out$celltype <- ct
    out
  }
)

if (nrow(kw_stats) > 0) {
  kw_stats <- kw_stats %>%
    dplyr::mutate(p_adj_cell = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")) %>%
    dplyr::select(celltype, dplyr::everything())
}

cat("\n--- Kruskal-Wallis (omnibus) by cell type ---\n")
print(kw_stats)

# ---- Dunn's post-hoc pairwise (BH within each cell type) ----
dunn_stats <- purrr::map_dfr(
  sort(unique(as.character(patient_df$celltype))),
  function(ct) {
    d <- patient_df %>% dplyr::filter(celltype == ct)
    if (!has_enough_obs(d)) return(NULL)
    out <- tryCatch(
      rstatix::dunn_test(d, density_per_mm2 ~ indication,
                         p.adjust.method = "BH"),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(out) || nrow(out) == 0) return(NULL)
    out$celltype <- ct
    out
  }
)

if (nrow(dunn_stats) > 0) {
  dunn_stats <- dunn_stats %>%
    dplyr::select(celltype, dplyr::everything())
}

cat("\n--- Dunn's pairwise post-hoc ---\n")
print(dunn_stats)

# ---- plotting ----
cols <- c("HC" = "#ffc700",
          "EN" = "#01c7e1",
          "EI" = "#fe2504")

plot_celltype_density <- function(ct,
                                  df    = patient_df,
                                  dunn  = dunn_stats) {
  d <- df %>% dplyr::filter(celltype == ct)

  # select only significant pairwise comparisons for this cell type
  # (guard against dunn being empty / having no 'celltype' column)
  if (!is.null(dunn) && nrow(dunn) > 0 && "celltype" %in% names(dunn)) {
    st <- dunn %>%
      dplyr::filter(celltype == ct, p.adj < 0.05) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        p_label = dplyr::case_when(
          p.adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
          p.adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
          TRUE          ~ "*"
        )
      )
  } else {
    st <- tibble::tibble()
  }

  # y positions for significance brackets (stacked above the max value)
  y_max <- max(d$density_per_mm2, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (nrow(st) > 0) {
    st <- st %>%
      dplyr::arrange(p.adj) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(y.position = y_max * (1.08 + 0.10 * (dplyr::row_number() - 1)))
  }

  p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = indication, y = density_per_mm2, fill = indication)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.6, alpha = 0.85,
                 linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.75, size = 2.2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cols) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
    labs(title = ct,
         x = NULL,
         y = expression("Cell density (cells per mm"^2*")")) +
    theme(plot.title   = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 20),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
          axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", color = "black"),
          axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", color = "black"),
          axis.line    = element_line(linewidth = 0.7),
          axis.ticks   = element_line(linewidth = 0.6),
          legend.position = "none")

  if (nrow(st) > 0) {
    p <- p + ggpubr::stat_pvalue_manual(
      st,
      label        = "p_label",
      tip.length   = 0.01,
      size         = 8,
      bracket.size = 0.7
    )
  }
  p
}

# cell types shown in Figure 2B (add or remove as needed)
cell_types_to_plot <- c(
  "Helper T-cells",
  "Cytotoxic T-cells",
  "Regulatory T-cells",
  "M1 Macrophages",
  "APCs",
  "DCs"
)

for (ct in cell_types_to_plot) {
  print(plot_celltype_density(ct))
}
```

# Fig 2C
```{r,fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
make_bar <- function(spe, title, cell_colors) {
  df <- as.data.frame(colData(spe)) |>
    tidyr::drop_na(celltype) |>
    dplyr::count(celltype, name = "n") |>
    filter(n > 0.0) |>
    mutate(pct = n / sum(n)) |>
    filter(pct >= 0.0001)
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = reorder(celltype, n), y = n, fill = celltype)) +
    geom_col() +
    coord_flip() +
    geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(pct, accuracy = 0.01)),   # 1 decimal place
              hjust = -0.1, size = 5) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Cells", title = title) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    expand_limits(y = max(df$n) * 1.12) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cell_colors, guide = "none")
}


make_bar(spe[,spe$indication=="HC"], "HC", metadata(spe)$color_vectors$celltype)
make_bar(spe[,spe$indication=="EN"], "EN", metadata(spe)$color_vectors$celltype)
make_bar(spe[,spe$indication=="EI"], "EI", metadata(spe)$color_vectors$celltype)
```

# assign clinical condition
```{r}
# Patient identifiers per clinical group are kept in a private file that is not shared
# (data/ is not part of the repository). It defines the character vectors
# autoimmune, infection, neoplasia, obesity, overweight and HN (patient_id values).
source(here::here("data", "patient_groups.R"))

sce <- spe
sce$Autoimmune <- ifelse(sce$patient_id %in% autoimmune, "Yes", "No")
sce$Infection  <- ifelse(sce$patient_id %in% infection, "Yes", "No")

# idiopathic = EN/EI patient without a documented autoimmune, infectious or neoplastic trigger;
# HC are NA so they are not counted
triggered_patients <- unique(c(autoimmune, infection, neoplasia))
sce$idiopathic <- NA_character_
sce$idiopathic[sce$indication %in% c("EN","EI")] <- "Yes"
sce$idiopathic[sce$patient_id %in% triggered_patients] <- "No"

sce$Obesity    <- ifelse(sce$patient_id %in% obesity, "Yes", "No")
sce$Overweight <- ifelse(sce$patient_id %in% overweight, "Yes", "No")
sce$HN         <- ifelse(sce$patient_id %in% HN, "Yes", "No")

df <- as.data.frame(colData(sce))
```


# Supplementary Figure 2B
```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)

# restrict to panniculitis patients (HC are NA for the idiopathic variable anyway)
sce_pann <- sce[, !is.na(sce$idiopathic)]

excluded_types <- c("Helper/Regulatory T-cells")

cd <- as.data.frame(colData(sce_pann))
cd <- cd[!cd$celltype %in% excluded_types, ]
# drop the excluded level so it doesn't come back via tidyr::complete
cd$celltype <- droplevels(factor(cd$celltype))

# Reorder cell types into biologically meaningful groups for the x-axis.
# Any cell types present in the data but not listed here will be appended at the end.
celltype_order <- c(
  # macrophage lineage
  "Macrophages", "M1 Macrophages", "M2 Macrophages",
  # antigen-presenting cells
  "DCs", "APCs",
  # granulocytes
  "Neutrophils",
  # T cells
  "Cytotoxic T-cells", "Helper T-cells", "Regulatory T-cells",
  # B cells
  "B-cells", "IgM B-cells",
  # stromal / other
  "Adipocytes", "Endothelial", "Others"
)
present     <- intersect(celltype_order, levels(cd$celltype))
unmentioned <- setdiff(levels(cd$celltype), celltype_order)
cd$celltype <- factor(cd$celltype, levels = c(present, unmentioned))

# patient-level metadata (one row per patient)
patient_meta <- cd %>%
  dplyr::distinct(patient_id, idiopathic)

n_idio_total      <- sum(patient_meta$idiopathic == "Yes")
n_triggered_total <- sum(patient_meta$idiopathic == "No")

# per-patient cell-type counts -> proportions, filling zeros for missing combinations
prop_df <- cd %>%
  dplyr::count(patient_id, celltype, name = "n") %>%
  tidyr::complete(patient_id, celltype, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(patient_id) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(proportion = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::left_join(patient_meta, by = "patient_id")

# Mann-Whitney per cell type + Benjamini-Hochberg FDR
stat_df <- prop_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(celltype) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_idio      = sum(idiopathic == "Yes"),
    n_triggered = sum(idiopathic == "No"),
    p = tryCatch(
      wilcox.test(proportion ~ idiopathic, exact = FALSE)$p.value,
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    p_adj   = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"),
    # only label cell types that reach significance after FDR correction
    p_label = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(p_adj)   ~ "",
      p_adj < 0.001  ~ "***",
      p_adj < 0.01   ~ "**",
      p_adj < 0.05   ~ "*",
      TRUE           ~ ""
    )
  )

print(stat_df)

# y position for significance labels (only for cell types surviving FDR)
label_y <- prop_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(celltype) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(y = max(proportion, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.08, .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(stat_df %>% dplyr::select(celltype, p_label), by = "celltype") %>%
  dplyr::filter(p_label != "")

any_significant <- nrow(label_y) > 0

subtitle_txt <- sprintf(
  "Idiopathic n = %d, Not idiopathic n = %d  |  Mann-Whitney U, Benjamini-Hochberg FDR  |  %s",
  n_idio_total, n_triggered_total,
  if (any_significant) "significant comparisons marked"
  else "no comparison reached significance (all adjusted p > 0.05)"
)

p <- ggplot(prop_df, aes(x = celltype, y = proportion, fill = idiopathic)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.6,
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.6) +
  geom_point(aes(color = idiopathic),
             position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.75),
             size = 1.6, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = c("Yes" = "#01c7e1", "No" = "#fe2504"),
                    labels  = c("Yes" = "Idiopathic", "No" = "Not idiopathic"),
                    breaks  = c("No", "Yes")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Yes" = "#01c7e1", "No" = "#fe2504"),
                     labels = c("Yes" = "Idiopathic", "No" = "Not idiopathic"),
                     breaks = c("No", "Yes")) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    text             = element_text(size = 14),
    plot.title       = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10.5, color = "grey30"),
    legend.position  = "right",
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  ) +
  labs(title    = "Cell-type proportions: idiopathic vs not idiopathic (pooled EN + EI)",
       subtitle = subtitle_txt,
       x = NULL, y = "Cell-type proportion per patient (%)",
       fill = NULL, color = NULL)

# only draw asterisks if any comparison survives FDR
if (any_significant) {
  p <- p + geom_text(data = label_y,
                     aes(x = celltype, y = y, label = p_label),
                     inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 5)
}

print(p)
```

# Supplementary Figure 3A, 3B
```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
# Autoimmune & Infection: per-patient proportions with Mann-Whitney + FDR
# Same method as the idiopathic analysis above (per-patient proportions,
# Mann-Whitney U, Benjamini-Hochberg FDR, boxplot with individual patient dots).
# Wrapped into a function so the logic is defined once and can be reused.
plot_celltype_by_group <- function(sce_obj,
                                   group_var,
                                   group_label   = group_var,
                                   yes_label     = "Yes",
                                   no_label      = "No",
                                   excluded_types = c("Helper/Regulatory T-cells"),
                                   restrict_to_pann = TRUE) {

  # restrict to panniculitis patients (HC would otherwise all be "No")
  if (restrict_to_pann) {
    sce_obj <- sce_obj[, sce_obj$indication %in% c("EN", "EI")]
  }

  cd <- as.data.frame(colData(sce_obj))
  cd <- cd[!cd$celltype %in% excluded_types, ]
  cd$celltype <- droplevels(factor(cd$celltype))

  # biologically meaningful cell-type order
  celltype_order <- c(
    "Macrophages", "M1 Macrophages", "M2 Macrophages",
    "DCs", "APCs",
    "Neutrophils",
    "Cytotoxic T-cells", "Helper T-cells", "Regulatory T-cells",
    "B-cells", "IgM B-cells",
    "Adipocytes", "Endothelial", "Others"
  )
  present     <- intersect(celltype_order, levels(cd$celltype))
  unmentioned <- setdiff(levels(cd$celltype), celltype_order)
  cd$celltype <- factor(cd$celltype, levels = c(present, unmentioned))

  # patient-level metadata using the chosen grouping variable
  cd$.group <- cd[[group_var]]
  patient_meta <- cd %>% dplyr::distinct(patient_id, .group)

  n_yes <- sum(patient_meta$.group == "Yes")
  n_no  <- sum(patient_meta$.group == "No")

  # per-patient proportions (fill zeros for missing combinations)
  prop_df <- cd %>%
    dplyr::count(patient_id, celltype, name = "n") %>%
    tidyr::complete(patient_id, celltype, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(patient_id) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(proportion = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::left_join(patient_meta, by = "patient_id")

  # Mann-Whitney per cell type + BH FDR
  stat_df <- prop_df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(celltype) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_yes = sum(.group == "Yes"),
      n_no  = sum(.group == "No"),
      p = tryCatch(
        wilcox.test(proportion ~ .group, exact = FALSE)$p.value,
        error = function(e) NA_real_
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      p_adj   = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"),
      p_label = dplyr::case_when(
        is.na(p_adj)  ~ "",
        p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
        p_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
        TRUE          ~ ""
      )
    )

  cat("\n--- ", group_label, " ---\n", sep = "")
  print(stat_df)

  label_y <- prop_df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(celltype) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(y = max(proportion, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.08, .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(stat_df %>% dplyr::select(celltype, p_label), by = "celltype") %>%
    dplyr::filter(p_label != "")

  any_significant <- nrow(label_y) > 0

  subtitle_txt <- sprintf(
    "%s n = %d, not %s n = %d  |  Mann-Whitney U, Benjamini-Hochberg FDR  |  %s",
    yes_label, n_yes, tolower(yes_label), n_no,
    if (any_significant) "significant comparisons marked"
    else "no comparison reached significance (all adjusted p > 0.05)"
  )

  p <- ggplot(prop_df, aes(x = celltype, y = proportion, fill = .group)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.6,
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.6) +
    geom_point(aes(color = .group),
               position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.75),
               size = 1.6, alpha = 0.85) +
    scale_fill_manual(values  = c("Yes" = "#01c7e1", "No" = "#fe2504"),
                      labels  = c("Yes" = yes_label,   "No" = no_label),
                      breaks  = c("No", "Yes")) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Yes" = "#01c7e1", "No" = "#fe2504"),
                       labels = c("Yes" = yes_label,  "No" = no_label),
                       breaks = c("No", "Yes")) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      text             = element_text(size = 14),
      plot.title       = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle    = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10.5, color = "grey30"),
      legend.position  = "right",
      axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    ) +
    labs(title    = sprintf("Cell-type proportions: %s vs %s (pooled EN + EI)",
                            yes_label, no_label),
         subtitle = subtitle_txt,
         x = NULL, y = "Cell-type proportion per patient (%)",
         fill = NULL, color = NULL)

  if (any_significant) {
    p <- p + geom_text(data = label_y,
                       aes(x = celltype, y = y, label = p_label),
                       inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 5)
  }

  print(p)
  invisible(stat_df)
}

# Autoimmune
stat_auto <- plot_celltype_by_group(sce, "Autoimmune",
                                    yes_label = "Autoimmune",
                                    no_label  = "Non-autoimmune")

# Infection
stat_inf  <- plot_celltype_by_group(sce, "Infection",
                                    yes_label = "Infection",
                                    no_label  = "No infection")
```
